_note: The RIVALS' moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.5; format in README.md). A rival met in data/cast.json rivals.met_min races becomes a person in the Rivals thread (at most rivals.max). Topic `rival`: on the evening after a race you both ran, with the chance rivals.note_chance one of them writes (StoryletSystem._post_rival_note; never a stop, outside the 3-5 a week). Sender conditions: rival_race beat (you finished ahead of them) / lost, rival_streak = their wins over you in a row, rival_wins = your wins over them in a row; their memory remembers 'nemesis' (the rival who always beats you: started after three losses in a row, ended by beating them). Youth rivals are fictional (minors).

text: Hey, it's {from}. We keep ending up in the same races, so I thought I'd say hi. Good race today.
{from} here, from today's race. That's the third time we race, I think? Respect.

replies.label: Hi! Good race to you too
replies.result: See you at the next one.

text: You got me today. That last 100 was strong. Next time.
OK, today was yours. Enjoy it, it won't last.
Good race. I died in the home straight. You didn't.
Good race today. You were close at the bell.
Thanks for the pace in the first lap, ha. Seriously, good run.

text.text: Told you. But you were closer than last time.

replies.label: Congrats, you were better
replies.result: Thanks. You're getting faster, I can feel it.

text: That's three in a row now. Not that I'm counting. OK, I'm counting.
Again! You should try going earlier. Or later. Or not at all, ha.

replies.label: I WILL beat you
replies.hint: {from} is now your rival for real

text: Same story. I'm starting to feel bad for you. A little.
Close today. Closer than ever. Still mine, though.
You know what I'm going to say.

replies.label: (Don't answer)
replies.result: You put the phone away and think about the bell lap.

text: ...OK. You finally did it. I didn't see you coming in the last 50. Congratulations. Really.
Well. That happened. Enjoy it. I'm going to train twice as hard now.

replies.label: FINALLY!
replies.result: You read it three times before you put the phone down. You beat {from}.

replies.label: You made me better
replies.result: ...Same. See you at the next one.

text: Three times in a row you've beaten me. What are you doing in training? Asking for a friend.
OK, you're the one to beat now. I'll be on your shoulder next time.
{pb}, that's a big PB! You're getting dangerous.
Saw your time. Great run. Now I have to go faster too.
Random question: how many kilometres do you run in a week? My coach says I do too little.
Do you do strength training? Mine says it's the secret. I'm not convinced.
Heard you're injured. Sorry. Races are boring without you. Get well.
Someone said you're out for a while. Racing isn't the same. Come back soon.

replies.label: Thanks, that means a lot
replies.result: Don't get too fast while resting, ha.
